sections.heading: 1. Week-by-week goals
lines: ① Wk 1: light weights, full body, 2–3 times.
② Wk 2: next-day soreness is common; move gently.
③ Wk 3: set feels easy? Add a little or 2 reps.
④ Wk 4: check sleep and recovery, then build.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get advice if…
lines: You get sharp pain during a lift, or
pins and needles down an arm or leg.

slides.heading: Worth a physio check if
items: Pins and needles in a limb

caption:
Signed up to a gym for the new year? The first month matters most.

Lots of new starters go too hard in week one, feel wrecked, and quietly stop going. A gradual start tends to stick.

Week 1: two or three full-body sessions with light weights. Week 2: some muscle soreness is common and usually settles within a few days. Week 3: if a set feels easy, add a little weight or a couple of reps. Week 4: check your sleep, recovery and enjoyment, then keep building.

Sharp pain during a lift, lingering pain or pins and needles down a limb is worth getting assessed. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio. 💪
